describes: the robot from 2026-11-22: battery-20261104 with its battery backpack (18 add-bp-* parts, 103.1 g) replaced by the battery backpack V2 rev M5 (print V1.47) with the Crazepony 2S 3000 mAh (11 add-bv2-* parts, 177.5 g); V1.35 orange A7Z saddle kept. Not weighed: printed frame and cap are CAD volume x 1.24 g/cm3 x 0.851 at the mesh centroid (guide/print/battery-v2-cad-20261120/mass_com.py method), battery 110 g from its listing, switch, DFR1202, plug, leads and screws at today's masses. Built 2026-11-21; made current 2026-11-22 when the battery arrived and the pack was being fitted (Shawn: "替换仿真里面的东西，因为今天或者明天我们就要装上了").
position_frame: Each part position is in its named MuJoCo body frame, metres; position_mm on trunk_base is the unshifted guide robot frame, x forward y left z up. No unconfirmed -8.7 mm Dual Lock shift.
excluded: No unconfirmed Dual Lock plate/strips or -8.7 mm mounting shift; four existing pack mounting screws retained.
Saddle lid not fitted; no lid added.
Ordered replacement camera cables are not installed; 1 m existing cable retained.
Full outer-shell and camera extrinsic scan registration remains independent of mass estimation.
NP-F970 90 g removal is applied by apply_masses.variant_parts, not repeated in this parts list.
Visual layer: cmu/model/visual-20261122 (fitted-20261122.json) draws the new backpack; physics does not use visual geoms.

estimation.method: add-bv2-* parts copied verbatim from extensions/flight-20261110/train/manifests/flightpack-d2-bv2-nominal.json (written by train/make_d2_bv2_manifest.py from the rev M5 build outputs, guide/print/battery-v2-cad-20261120/build/build.json).
estimation.uncertainty: Nothing weighed; printed masses use the prior 0.851 effective fraction (examine +/-20%).
estimation.status: current robot (2026-11-22); masses estimated, not weighed
